latest.title: UBS pre-tax profits jump 27% to $3.59 billion in the third quarter
Here’s what happened in crypto today
latest.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

latest.title: SK Hynix shares soar over 10 % as profit beats, chipmaker to return $25 billion to investors
latest.description: Shares of South Korean chipmaker SK Hynix soared over 10% on Wednesday as third-quarter profit sharply beats estimates.

latest.title: Oil prices rise as Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabian refinery raise supply worries
latest.description: Oil prices climbed Wednesday as investors weighed the prospect of a prolonged conflict in the Middle East.

latest.title: Bitcoin treasury Datavault AI plunges 50% after firm says it can’t access its BTC
latest.description: The company said the accounting correction will cut reported assets by $92.2 million at the end of 2025 after bitcoin held on Biconomy could not be withdrawn.

latest.title: Meta- and Google-backed Jio Platforms’ shares soar over 21% on trading debut after record IPO
latest.description: Jio had offered 270 million shares in the IPO priced at 1,119 rupees apiece, raising 302 billion rupees ($3.2 billion) in the country's largest-ever IPO.

latest.title: Bithumb hacked through employee system as South Korean financial firms face cyberattacks
latest.description: The breach hit an internal employee system that Bithumb says is separate from its trading platform, while the exchange is still determining whether customer information was exposed.

latest.title: Trump jokes $5,000 would buy 'a hamburger and maybe a small dessert' at Mar-a-Lago as cost of living looms over midterms
latest.description: Trump joked that the $5,000 payments for U.S. adults would buy little more than "a hamburger and maybe a small dessert" as cost of living looms over midterms.

latest.title: Bitcoin nears $81,000 ahead of Fed decision as ZEC jumps 8%
latest.description: Majors outpaced bitcoin across the board as tech stocks extended a climb.

latest.title: Robinhood’s Tenev warns US tokenization uncertainty deters ‘serious assets’
latest.description: Robinhood CEO Vlad Tenev says tokenized equities need more than a temporary SEC exemption to flourish in the US.

latest.title: Kylian Mbappé faces China backlash as sponsors cut ties over viral meme
latest.description: Chinese state media has warned Kylian Mbappé that his apology over remarks referring to Mao Zedong as a dictator will be judged against his actions.

latest.title: Coinbase says user funds are safe after third-party vendor exposes customer contact info
latest.description: The crypto exchange says an incident at analytics firm Amplitude exposed some customer contact information, but insists its own systems were not breached.

latest.title: Trump says Iran war will end 'when I want it to' as costs reportedly balloon to $47 billion
latest.description: Trump's statement comes as a report from The Hill revealed that the costs of the Iran conflict has ballooned to $47 billion.

latest.title: Labubu-maker Pop Mart's shares extend declines as third-quarter sales plunge
latest.description: The company reported a 45% to 50% year-on-year drop in third-quarter revenue.

latest.title: Bithumb discloses data leak after internal system breach: Report
latest.description: The breach impacted its in-house mobile system, used by employees for work and information sharing.

latest.title: Israel election appears to have no clear winner with Netanyahu, opponent Eisenkot far short of majorities
latest.description: Exit polls show Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's alliance and Gadi Eisenkot's opposition bloc both well off the numbers needed to form a governing majority.

latest.title: Discord is making public chats searchable on Google: How to opt out
latest.description: Discord conversations on large public servers will soon reach audiences far beyond their communities, raising privacy concerns.

latest.title: Indian investors rush to Nvidia, SpaceX, Apple as local trading apps roll out access to U.S. stocks
latest.description: Major Indian brokerages are providing retail investors access to U.S. stocks at a time when the local market has been battered.

latest.title: Grand jury rejects DOJ bid to indict ex-Trump WH aide Cassidy Hutchinson: Reports
latest.description: Prosecutors aimed to charge Cassidy Hutchinson over testimony about President Trump's conduct the day of the Jan. 6, 2021, U.S. Capitol riot by his supporters.

latest.title: Chart: Anthropic's cash pile towers over nearly every U.S. company
latest.description: Anthropic's cash pile of $131.7 billion is more than every non-bank U.S. company except for Berkshire Hathaway and Alphabet.
